## Checklist
- [ ] I opened a Discussion first if this is more than a small bug fix
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python3 -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] I will sign the CLA when the bot asks (one-time)
- [ ] Change is focused and matches the surrounding style
- [ ] Issue links: `Closes #N` only if this PR fully addresses N; otherwise `Part of #N`. (A `Closes` closes the issue when this merges, also into `release/*`.)
